summary: Vistance Networks filed an 8-K reporting third-quarter 2026 results and disclosing board authorization of an additional $100 million common stock repurchase program. This supplements prior authorizations of $100 million (announced April 30, 2026) and $150 million (announced August 26, 2026). Repurchases may occur via open market or privately negotiated transactions, potentially under Rule 10b-18 and Rule 10b5-1 plans, with timing, method and amount dependent on liquidity, capital needs and market conditions. No price, premium or expiration was stated, and the program is non-binding and may be modified, suspended or discontinued. Watch cumulative authorization size versus free cash flow and buyback pace.
